claim: USDA FoodData Central data are public domain, published under CC0 1.0.
quote: USDA FoodData Central data are in the public domain and they are not copyrighted. They are published under CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)

claim: USDA asks users to list FoodData Central as the source.
quote: No permission is needed for their use, but we request that users list FoodData Central as the source of the data

claim: DEMO_KEY is documented for exploring the API before signing up, with lower limits.
quote: This API key can be used for initially exploring APIs prior to signing up, but it has much lower rate limits

claim: DEMO_KEY allows 30 requests per IP address per hour and 50 per day.
quote: Hourly Limit: 30 requests per IP address per hour

claim: DEMO_KEY allows 50 requests per IP address per day.
quote: Daily Limit: 50 requests per IP address per day

claim: FoodData Central gives a food a new fdcId whenever its record changes.
quote: Each time the data in a food record changes, that food item receives a new FDC_ID number.

claim: The Open Food Facts database is under the Open Database License.
quote: The Open Food Facts database is available under the Open Database License

claim: Individual contents are under the Database Contents License.
quote: Individual contents of the database are available under the Database Contents License

claim: Re-users must name the license and credit Open Food Facts with a link.
quote: have to mention the licence and to attribute the authorship to Open Food Facts with a link to https://openfoodfacts.org

claim: Derivative works must be shared under the same conditions.
quote: Derivative works must be shared under the same conditions.

claim: Open Food Facts does not guarantee the accuracy of its data.
quote: Open Food Facts does not guarantee the accuracy of the information and data present on the site and in the database

claim: The ODbL requires a derivative database that is publicly used to be offered under the ODbL.
quote: If you publicly use any adapted version of this database, or works produced from an adapted database, you must also offer that adapted database under the ODbL.

claim: The ODbL's example notice for a produced work.
quote: Contains information from DATABASE NAME, which is made available here under the Open Database License (ODbL).

claim: Open Food Facts limits search requests to 10 per minute per IP address.
quote: 10 req/min/IP address for all search queries

claim: Open Food Facts asks every client to send a custom User-Agent.
quote: We ask you to **always use a custom User-Agent to identify your app**

claim: Open Food Facts gives no assurance its data is accurate or complete.
quote: there are no assurances that the data is accurate, complete, or reliable.

claim: Open Food Facts answers 503 when its global rate limits are exceeded.
quote: A HTTP 503 response (Service Not Available) will be returned if these limits are exceeded.

claim: The v2 search's sort_by values include unique_scans_n, a popularity measure.
quote: `scans_n`, `unique_scans_n` and `popularity_key` are about product popularity

claim: Open Food Facts read requests need no authentication beyond a custom User-Agent.
quote: READ operations (getting info about a product, etc...) do not require authentication other than the custom User-Agent.

claim: The v2 search filters by category tag; it is the structured search Open Food Facts documents.
quote: Structured (filter-based) search by categories, brands, nutrients, and other fields is available in API v2 via the `/api/v2/search` endpoints.
